name: Search field
purpose: A text input specialised for search, with a search icon, optional label/help text, and an optional predictive-search (autocomplete) dropdown that suggests matching results as the user types.

props.name: predictive
props.$note: Predictive-search menu open below the field (single-select list, scrollable).

props.name: label
props.$note: Optional field label + help text + tooltip (Input label).

tokens.field-background: form/background/default (transparent #ffffff00), hover form/background/hover (#f3f3f3); active field surface background/default (#ffffff)
tokens.active-bottom-stroke (DEPRECATED effect): INNER_SHADOW 'bottom stroke/active' bound to interactive (depricate)/on-light/border/active/default (#000) → rebind form/border/active
tokens.text: text/default (#333) @ font-5 medium (value) / light (placeholder, help text)
tokens.predictive-menu: background/default surface + elevation/functional (DROP_SHADOW blur 16) + divider/border/subsection (#ededed item dividers) + scrollbar/foreground #767676 / scrollbar/background #ededed

accessibility.label: Field needs a programmatic label (search label); placeholder is not a label
accessibility.role: Use role=search / combobox semantics for predictive search; expose aria-expanded + aria-activedescendant for the suggestion list
accessibility.focus: Visible focus outline on tab (per HSBC Accessibility Framework); target area covers the whole trigger + tooltip icon
accessibility.textSize: Must not break at 400% text zoom; don't disable browser pinch-and-zoom
accessibility.announce: Suggestion results should be announced (aria-live) as they update

antiPatterns: Using placeholder as the only label
Disabling pinch-and-zoom or breaking layout at 400% text size
Predictive list without combobox/listbox semantics + keyboard navigation
Leaving the active bottom-stroke bound to the deprecated token — rebind to form/border/active (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — same FORM pattern as Input fields: chrome on form/*; only the active 'bottom stroke' inner-shadow effect still binds 1 deprecated token (clean rebind). Predictive list items + menu fully live.

tokens.usedBy: Search field active 'bottom stroke' inner-shadow effect

depricateUsage.note: Identical to Input fields / Dropdown: the field chrome uses live form/* but the active underline EFFECT still references the deprecated border token. Predictive-search list items use the live tertiary/background/* state set (clean); menu surface/divider/scrollbar/elevation all live.
